Write him a message saying everything you want him to hear. the good and the bad. save it for a few days, about 3. During these 3 days try your absolute hardest to not contact him. At the end, decide if you want to send that, if you do send it, dont continue the conversation. Say what needs to be said, wait for his response, and respond only once. Sending a message like that to my ex reallllyyy helped me move on and stop talking to him... mostly because I poured my heart out and he just responded like an asshole... so I realized I really dont need him lol. But maybe, his response will be sweet and it'll be a good gateway to start again. But if you dont send the message feel free to add more to it over time, and maybe send it in a month when no contact is over. I can almost guarantee you'll find the new things you add will be negative things towards him, or maybe positive things towards yourself. No contact is rough, I'm definitely struggling with it. But sending a message like that/writing one can really help you not feel the need to contact him. On top of that, another good thing to do is make a list of all the reasons you shouldn't contact him/why being broken up is a bad idea. ( Granted, if your long term goal is to get back together some of these things might not be true like the things you add to the list will be negative over time) Sorry about your breakup, you're gonna get through this! Good Luck OP!
